task_description: Move the backdrop/cover image from the DetailHero section to become the background of the PlayerBox (embed player area). When not playing, the player area shows the backdrop with a play button overlay. DetailHero becomes a clean info section without the large backdrop. Apply to both web and mobile surfaces.

verification.summary: Web build (vite) passes cleanly. Web lint (eslint) passes. Mobile lint (expo lint) passes. No test files were modified (no tests exist for these UI components). Docker not applicable.

details: Removed onPlay from DetailHero in movie/[id].jsx and tv/[id].jsx to eliminate duplicate play buttons
Replaced static Dimensions.get with useWindowDimensions hook in mobile PlayerBox
Added backdrop_url to player route params and prefer it over poster_url in player screen
Added poster_url fallback in web PlayerBox for missing backdrop_url
